response.overview: A documentary film exploring farming, landscape and rural communities in the Cotswolds, following the changing seasons and the people who shape the land.  Through the voices of farmers, historians, conservationists, and local people, the film reveals how centuries of working the land have shaped the hills, fields, and villages we see today. As the seasons turn, it explores the challenges facing rural life - from changing farming practices to environmental pressures, while celebrating those who are working to care for the land and keep its traditions alive.
response.title: Cotswolds: Field & Folk
